reasons: Directionally correct: the flagged obligation in Section 3.4(b) is an unspecified, uncapped early-termination charge payable by Customer (confirmed as recoverable by IBM under Section 3.3/p0042), squarely within the rule's scope of Customer-payable liquidated amounts.

The redline achieves the preferred position by removing the early-termination charge and adding an express statement that Customer owes no early termination charge, penalty, liquidated damages, or unearned minimum, while preserving the list structure by substituting a benign obligation to pay charges accrued for Services actually performed.

The advisory changed-character ratio (0.850) is justified here: the entire subsection consisted of the offending obligation, so replacement rather than surgical edit is unavoidable; the substituted language does not create new Customer exposure.

Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice and prefix, explains the unilateral-amendment concern regarding Attachment A/Section 13.1, and correctly offers the fallback of a single early-termination charge capped at three months' recurring charges.

Rule coverage is adequate: no other Customer-payable liquidated amounts exist in the cited text (Section 4.2 is late-payment interest; Section 9.2 limits Customer liability), and the surviving cross-reference in Section 3.3 becomes harmless once the charge is deleted.
